C:P2.6.text: The Canada segment operates primarily under the Wolseley brand and supplies plumbing, HVAC and refrigeration products to residential and commercial contractors. In addition, our Canada business operates one MDC in Brampton, Ontario (Toronto) for branch replenishment and final mile distribution.
